caveats: The formation-focused Conquest selection is a coordinator-chosen owner compilation, not a published trade or the complete event.
Provider labels ANNIHILATION: CONQUEST PROLOGUE 1 and Annihilation: Conquest - Starlord are retained separately from bibliographic wording; exact series IDs, years and issue numbers are unchanged.

The prologue and Rocket Raccoon (2014) #1-6 provider creator arrays omit writer roles. Bibliographic authorship is retained independently; cached creator arrays are not claimed to be exhaustive or rewritten.

The Legacy paperback publication year is 2009; its original issues are from the 2008 series. Collection publication years and original on-sale dates remain distinct; no unverified exact collection date is inferred.
Then It's Us has five selected originals. The six-issue retailer description is a recorded bibliography conflict, not a sixth selected row.

Ewing recency and High Evolutionary film relevance are unsupported intake framing for this first trade and are excluded from proposed copy. No claim of exhaustive character absence or one-to-one film adaptation is made.
Conquest develops a precursor squad and the ongoing Guardians series follows it; do not identify that squad as exactly the film roster or promise strict in-universe chronology.
Provider digital IDs and unlimitedDate values are cached metadata only, not a Marvel Unlimited availability claim.
